title: Why Is Your Water Flow Suddenly Weak?
description: Notice your kitchen faucet or shower losing its usual power? Low water pressure is a common issue for homeowners, but it usually stems from a few specific causes. Mineral buildup inside older pipes can gradually restrict water flow over time. A faulty pressure regulator, a partially closed main shut-off valve, or a hidden pipe leak can also cause a sudden drop across the entire property. If only one faucet is affected, a clogged aerator might be the simple culprit. However, if weak flow impacts your whole home, contacting a licensed plumber ensures an accurate diagnosis and a safe solution.
